title: The pre-upgrade backup keys on the app version string while the migrations key on user_version, so the shipped 0.8.0 profile (marker 0.8.0) is migrated 0 -> 1 by this 0.8.0 candidate with no backup
repro: rc1-seed-data (the operator's 0.8.0 profile snapshot): data_cache meta.build = 0.8.0 and every DB at user_version 0. Booting the candidate (FastAPI version 0.8.0) on a copy moved all 7 stores to user_version 1 and created no backups/ dir. Harmless today because step 1 is the pre-versioning schema. A schema step shipped without a version bump would run with no backup. With an older marker (0.7.5) the backup does fire and a second boot is a no-op (verified in-process).
